comments.text:
I recently had a very disappointing experience with Go Digit Insurance while trying to claim insurance for my car, and I believe people should know about it before purchasing a policy.

I own a Hyundai Venue which is insured with Go Digit General Insurance. During a family trip to Chakrata, Uttarakhand, my vehicle hit a deep pothole on a hilly road. Due to the impact, the tyre was damaged and the urea sensor assembly underneath the vehicle got hit and was left hanging. I immediately reported the incident and submitted my claim with complete honesty. I also provided clear photographs showing the physical damage to the sensor and the underbody.

However, instead of properly investigating the matter, the insurance company rejected the claim stating that “the damage does not correlate with the cause of loss” and that there was “no evidence of external impact.” This response was shocking because the photos clearly show the sensor hanging due to impact damage.

What made the situation worse is that:
• No proper technical report was shared with me.
• No detailed explanation was given about how they reached their conclusion.
• My vehicle has been lying in the garage since 2 March 2026.
• The surveyor simply stated verbally that the claim cannot be approved.

As a policyholder who has paid premiums on time, I expected transparency and a fair investigation. If an insurance company rejects a claim, they should provide proper evidence, survey findings, or a technical inspection report. Rejecting a claim with a generic statement without sharing proof raises serious concerns about the claim settlement process.

My experience has been frustrating and stressful. Insurance is supposed to help customers in difficult situations, but in my case, it has been the opposite.

I would strongly advise potential customers to carefully review the claim settlement practices of Go Digit Insurance before purchasing a policy. A smooth buying experience means nothing if the company does not support you when you actually need the claim.

I am currently escalating this issue through the grievance process and hope the company reviews the case fairly.

If anyone else has faced similar issues with Go Digit Insurance, I would be interested to know how your claim was handled.
